issue_description: Internal DNS resolution failing for all employees on VPN. Systems resolvable by IP but not hostname. Widespread productivity impact.
DB-CONN-POOL-99 on NEXACORE-DB replica used for reporting. Analytics team running unoptimized queries consuming all available connections.
ERR-AUTH-8801 — AUTH-GATEWAY health check failing after NTP drift caused certificate validity window check to fail. Clocks corrected. Service restored.
Docker image for the payments-service failed Trivy security scan. Critical CVE-2024-1234 found in base image. Push to registry blocked.
SYNC-FAIL-2201B — AWS IAM role for CLOUDSYNC-S3 service account lost S3:PutObject permission after Priya Nair's quarterly IAM policy tightening.
FW-RULE-9910 detected after Simone Reyes requested a temporary exception rule be added. Rule conflicts with existing ZONE-PROD egress policy.
NEXASEC-FW IDS engine detected signature match for known SQL injection pattern against APIGATEWAY-V2. Potential intrusion attempt in progress.
BUILD-PIPE-ERR-88 — intermittent Jenkins agent disconnection causing pipeline failures. Root cause: JVM memory leak in Jenkins LTS 2.414. Upgrading to 2.426.
API-TIMEOUT-7720 affecting all OAuth2 clients after AUTH-GATEWAY certificate rotation performed by Marcus Thompson. JWT signing key changed.
SYNC-FAIL-2201B recurrence — third failure this week. AWS S3 API credentials used by CLOUDSYNC-S3 may have expired or been rotated.
APIGATEWAY-V2 developer portal showing outdated API documentation for /v2/payments endpoint. Causing confusion for external developers. Content update needed.
SYNC-DELTA-441C recurrence on the /hr/personnel directory. Root cause identified as concurrent file writes during HRPORTAL data export.
Remote employee Raj Patel unable to establish NEXAVPN tunnel. VPN client shows certificate error on connection attempt.
HR-LDAP-552 during emergency offboarding. Departing employee's LDAP account removal caused cascade group policy failure. AUTH-GATEWAY disruption for 5 minutes.
VPN-HANDSHAKE-003 after NEXASEC-FW TLS policy updated to drop TLS 1.1. Legacy VPN client version 3.2 incompatible. Forced upgrade rollout initiated.
BACKUP-CHKSUM-77Z on HRPORTAL database backup. Checksum mismatch detected for personnel_records table dump. Lena Kovacs and Simone Reyes notified.
BUILD-DOCKER-55X for the internal-api-service image. Critical CVE in base Debian image. Nathan Xu updating to patched base image and resubmitting.
API-RATE-4429 complaint from NexaRetail partner. Investigation shows their API key was erroneously downgraded to free tier during Raj Patel's rate limit configuration update.
BUILDPIPE-CI dependency resolver failing for Python microservice. PyPI package version conflict preventing build completion for 3 teams.
HRPORTAL Workday integration sync failed overnight. Employee leave balances showing stale data from 48 hours ago across entire company.
NEXACORE-DB connection pool exhausted during peak trading window. Application servers queuing requests. Potential P1 escalation.
MAIL-QUEUE-8823 following spam campaign spoofing nexacorp.com domain. Inbound queue flooded with NDR bounce-backs. SPF record tightening required.
SYNC-DELTA-441C — CLOUDSYNC-S3 manifest inconsistency found during DR failover test. Chloe Fontaine performing full manifest rebuild. ETA 4 hours.
FW-RULE-9910 — post-audit by Simone Reyes revealed 14 orphaned firewall rules from decommissioned systems. Cleanup completed and verified by Priya Nair.
NEXASEC-FW detected duplicate and conflicting firewall rules introduced during last maintenance window. Rule evaluation order corrupted.
HRPORTAL users unable to authenticate. LDAP connector to AUTH-GATEWAY returning authentication failure for all AD accounts.
API-RATE-4429 — Raj Patel misconfigured rate limit policy file in APIGATEWAY-V2 during a hotfix deployment. All consumers downgraded. Immediately rolled back.
DB-CONN-POOL-99 spike during end-of-month reporting. 200 application threads queued waiting for connection. NEXACORE-DB unresponsive for 8 minutes.
Outbound SPF validation failing for emails sent from NEXAMAIL relay host due to IP not being listed in DNS SPF record after infrastructure migration.
NEXABACKUP tape rotation job failed. Previous week's tapes not released for offsite collection. Compliance deadline at risk.
NEXACORE-DB query running analytics report exceeded 300-second threshold and was killed by Oracle Resource Manager. Report never completed.
BACKUP-ROTATE-33 third occurrence this month. Tape library robot arm fault causing intermittent failure in offsite rotation. Vendor called.
BACKUP-CHKSUM-77Z — Q4 annual backup verification failed on 2 of 8 tape sets. Restore drill scheduled by Farida Hassan to confirm recoverability.
VPN-HANDSHAKE-003 for users on macOS 14.4 Sonoma after OS update. OpenSSL compatibility issue with NEXAVPN client 3.4.1.
VPN-DNS-1882 affecting employees at the Singapore office after BGP route update. Internal hostnames not resolving correctly through VPN tunnel.
BUILDPIPE-CI pipeline for customer-portal project erroring at stage 3 (integration tests). BUILD-PIPE-ERR-88 in CI logs. Release delayed by 2 days.
BUILDPIPE-CI pipeline for project Hydra failed at the test-runner stage with exit code 88. All deployments blocked.
HR-SESSION-992 reported by 20+ employees simultaneously. Suspected HRPORTAL session manager memory leak after yesterday's patch deployment.
BUILD-DEP-ERR-21 for Node.js analytics service. Deprecated npm package causing build chain failure across 5 dependent services.
HR-SYNC-8812 — Workday sync failed to push updated salary data after Q3 pay review approved by Lena Kovacs. Payslip generation impacted.
APIGATEWAY-V2 JWT token validation timing out for mobile app consumers. Token appears valid on inspection but gateway returns 401.
LDAP directory sync failure on AUTH-GATEWAY. New hires onboarded by Lena Kovacs this morning cannot log in to any NexaCorp system.
FW-IDS-2209 alert from Snort IDS — brute force pattern detected against AUTH-GATEWAY login endpoint. Source IP blocked. Priya Nair notified.
APIGATEWAY-V2 consumer TechFusion reporting API-RATE-4429 errors despite being on the premium tier. Rate limiter configuration may be stale.
FW-IDS-2209 — Snort alert for command-and-control beacon pattern from a developer workstation. Host quarantined. Priya Nair initiating incident response.
MONITORX threshold-breach alert fired for NEXACORE-DB CPU exceeding 92% sustained for 45 minutes. Investigating root cause.
HR-SESSION-992 reported by Lena Kovacs — HRPORTAL session timeout occurring mid-performance-review workflow causing data loss.
DB-LOCK-1192X involving the AUDIT_LOG table and a maintenance script run by Farida Hassan. Long-held lock blocking 15 application queries.

ERR-AUTH-9092 for Anita Sharma — CTO unable to access any system before board meeting. YubiKey 5 serial number mismatch in Vault. Emergency reprovisioning.
BUILD-PIPE-ERR-88 — SonarQube quality gate failed for auth-service. Code coverage dropped below 80% threshold after merge. Build gate enforced.
ERR-AUTH-9092 for all users enrolled in YubiKey MFA after Vault token rotation. Approximately 40 users affected. Business-wide access blocked.

VPN-CERT-7731 for all iOS devices after MDM certificate push failed silently. 28 mobile users unable to connect to NEXAVPN.
DB-TIMEOUT-404X on cross-schema join query submitted by Raj Patel for the reporting dashboard. Query plan shows full table scan on 400M row table.

MONITOR-DISK-88A on NEXABACKUP cold storage node. Archive partition at 89% capacity. Retention policy review required with Farida Hassan.

DB-CONN-POOL-99 recurrence during batch processing window. Pool size appears insufficient for concurrent ETL loads. Requires parameter tuning.
Multiple employees reporting HRPORTAL session logging them out after 2 minutes of inactivity instead of the configured 30 minutes.

MAIL-SPF-4401 — bulk marketing emails sent via third-party platform failing SPF because platform IPs not added to DNS record. Coordinating with marketing team.

MONITORX reporting disk utilization at 91% on NEXACORE-DB primary node. Redo log archive destination will fill in approximately 6 hours.

TLS handshake failure for VPN tunnels established from the Chicago branch office. Affects all 34 employees at that site.

Second occurrence of DB-TIMEOUT-404X in 24 hours. Monthly financial reconciliation query timed out again. Requires query plan optimization.

APIGATEWAY-V2 returning HTTP 429 to external partner Nexbridge LLC. Their integration is blocked. Rate limit appears misconfigured.
